dbError.title: The local database could not be opened
dbError.body: Pharos has not modified any file. Close the app and try again; if it keeps happening, share this detail with support.
dbError.newerTitle: This data comes from a newer version of Pharos
dbError.newerBody: The local database was saved by a more recent version than this one. To avoid damaging it, Pharos neither opens nor modifies it. Install that version or a later one.
dbError.keyMissingTitle: The local database key is missing
dbError.keyMismatchTitle: The stored key does not open the local database
dbError.keyBody: Your data is still encrypted on this computer, but its key is not in the system credential store (this happens on a new PC or after reinstalling Windows). Enter the recovery key you saved from Profile to open it. Pharos changes no file until the key is right.

recovery.label: Recovery key
recovery.hint: 56 characters in groups of 4. Case, spaces and hyphens do not matter.
recovery.invalid: The key has a typo: check each group and try again.
recovery.wrong: The key is valid, but it does not open this database: it is another key, or the file is damaged. Make sure it is the one for this computer; if it is, a pharos.db.enc.bak-… copy may open with it (README, Recovery key).

recoveryKey.title: Recovery key
recoveryKey.intro: The local database is encrypted and its key lives only in this computer's credential store. If you lose it (new PC, reinstalled Windows), only the recovery key together with your copy of pharos.db.enc brings your data back.
recoveryKey.desktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app.
recoveryKey.failed: Could not read the recovery key.
recoveryKey.confirmBody: Anyone with this key and a copy of your data can read it. Show it only when nobody is looking at your screen.
recoveryKey.guidePaper: Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, or
recoveryKey.guideManager: store it in a password manager.
recoveryKey.guideRisk: Do not send it by email or chat, and do not keep it next to the copy of your data.
recoveryKey.guideBackup: To restore on another computer you need this key and a copy of pharos.db.enc (and of the evidence/ folder once it exists). Pharos cannot recover it for you.
recoveryKey.copiedHint: Paste it into your password manager, then copy something else to clear the clipboard.
recoveryKey.savedCheck: I have saved it somewhere safe
